title: Remote & Hybrid Work Policy
body: Acme Corp is hybrid by default: most teams are expected in the office Tuesday–Thursday, with Monday and Friday flexible. Fully remote arrangements require manager and HR approval and are evaluated case by case based on role and team needs. Employees working outside their home state/country for more than 30 days in a year must notify HR for tax and compliance reasons. Home-office equipment stipend: $500 one-time, available after 90 days of employment.
